rationale: The engine Service exposes the LMCache/KV-transfer control ports (zmq 55555 and ucx 9999) as named ClusterIP Service ports alongside the inference port, making them reachable cluster-wide rather than only between the engine pods.

rule_title: Inference workload uses hostNetwork or hostPID
label: ABSENT
rationale: The engine pod spec sets neither hostNetwork nor hostPID (API default false).

rule_title: Secret-like literal appears in values or ConfigMap
label: ABSENT
rationale: No credential-like literal appears in any field; the included Secret is empty and the model is public.

rule_title: Token-like environment variable uses literal value rather than secretKeyRef
label: ABSENT
rationale: No token-like environment variable is present in the bundle (no HF_TOKEN is set).

rule_title: Inference ServiceAccount has broad or cluster-admin permissions
label: U
rationale: The engine runs under the default ServiceAccount with no bindings in the bundle (the only included binding gives the router SA a least-privilege pods-reader Role), so the engine account's effective permissions are determined outside the bundle.

rule_title: GPU-serving container lacks vendor GPU resource request/limit
label: ABSENT
rationale: Vendor GPU resources (nvidia.com/gpu: 1) are explicitly requested and limited on the engine container.

rule_title: GPU multi-tenant isolation controls are not evidenced
label: U
rationale: A single GPU is requested for the engine, but static YAML cannot establish co-location or tenant isolation at runtime.

rule_title: GPU workload uses privileged mode, dangerous capabilities, or broad host-device mounts
label: ABSENT
rationale: The engine container is not privileged, adds no capabilities, and mounts no host device paths; GPU access is via device-plugin resource requests.

rule_title: Inference container does not explicitly require non-root execution
label: PRESENT
rationale: The engine container explicitly sets runAsNonRoot: false.

rule_title: Inference container does not explicitly use a read-only root filesystem
label: PRESENT
rationale: The engine container does not set readOnlyRootFilesystem: true.

rule_title: Inference container does not explicitly disable privilege escalation
label: PRESENT
rationale: The engine container does not explicitly set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false.

rule_title: Inference workload lacks an evidenced seccomp/AppArmor profile
label: PRESENT
rationale: No seccomp profile is configured on the engine pod and no AppArmor annotation is present.

rule_title: Inference image uses latest or lacks immutable digest
label: PRESENT
rationale: The engine image vllm/vllm-openai:latest uses the mutable latest tag with no digest (the router image is also :latest).

rule_title: Model/cache storage has potentially unsafe sharing or permissions
label: NA
rationale: The bundle contains no storage volumes or claims (HF_HOME points at /tmp).

rule_title: Model/cache path uses a potentially untrusted writable volume
label: NA
rationale: The engine pod template declares no volumes or mounts.

rule_title: Model download initContainer has excess privilege or token exposure
label: NA
rationale: The bundle contains no initContainers.

rule_title: Inference container lacks CPU/memory requests or limits
label: PRESENT
rationale: The engine container's limits carry only the GPU resource; CPU and memory limits are absent.

rule_title: Production-like replicated inference workload lacks a PDB
label: U
rationale: The tutorial runs a single engine replica and includes no PDB; as a tutorial values bundle its production intent cannot be determined.

rule_title: Inference container lacks readiness/startup probes
label: ABSENT
rationale: The engine container configures readiness and startup probes (httpGet /health) in addition to liveness.
